name: Common Misconceptions
summary: Things everyone says that aren't so.

sections.heading: Not true
sections.body:
1. *The Original Vampire pass costs 1,800 Robux.* It is 1,895, or 1,706 with Premium.
2. *You choose Natural-Born at spawn*, or *it's a 1% roll.* It comes with the [[original-vampire-pass]].
3. *Turning is just dying*, or *just being bitten.* It takes vampire blood, death and fresh blood: see [[human-to-vampire]].
4. *You become a ghost when killed.* There is no ghost state; you respawn.
5. *Vampires can hide in churches.* They burn there and can't enter.
6. *A Temporary Sun Ring costs exactly X.* Several prices circulate.
7. *Werewolves come from a quest, boss or shop.* Only a back scratch, at 5%, then the full moon.
8. *Cannibal Raised is cosmetic.* It is a stronger variant, and it resets your level.
9. *An Original's bite makes you an Original*, or *you can level into one.* Only the game pass does.
